messages:
anya: Dropped a new chart iteration for the dashboard - single-axis density stripe with mini-hist bars. Mock: https://redwood.design/r/strip-density
sam: Nice compact approach. two asks: 1) make it explicit when values are clipped (e.g., 99.9th pct), 2) unit control needs to affect tooltips too
lee: Smoothing concern: current default blurs micro-bursts. can we add presets none / light / auto? Auto should respect recent variance and avoid hiding short spikes
olivia: A11y: stripe fill vs mini-bars has low contrast for some colorblind palettes. suggest palette-v4 and a dashed outline for hovered outliers. SR text should summarize median/p95 and mention clipping when active
anya: Plan: add a units dropdown labeled "Units (axis & tooltips)", smoothing presets, clip the stripe to 99.9% and render clipped values as outlined bars with tooltips revealing the full values
sam: If clipped, axis label should append "(values clipped to 99.9%)". tooltip must show original un-clipped number and timestamp with a link to traces
design-bot: Added checklist item to D-1402: units copy, smoothing presets, clipping indicator, color palette update, screen-reader summary
lee: Copy nit: legend helper should read "Select units used by axis and tooltips". Also when switching to seconds, force tick formatting to 2 decimals for subsecond numbers
olivia: :thumbsup: I'll add Storybook fixtures for each smoothing preset and axe snapshots for the new palette
